language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The robot closes its gripper around the wooden spoon at frames 45–52 (wrist_image), lifts and carries it at frames 60–115 (image, left_ego_image, wrist_image), and lowers it into the open drawer at frames 150–162 (image, wrist_image). At frames 163–173, the spoon rests inside the drawer while the empty gripper withdraws (image, wrist_image). No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visible.
